card.name: Clear solution in appearance checks
card.fires_on: The word "clear" (or the comma right after it) when a product is described as a clear, colorless solution. It appears in visual inspection instructions before administration.

modes.label: Clear after "is a"
modes.description: The word "clear" right after "is a" or "should be a" when describing the look of a liquid drug.
